comment: display.c wall_angle() for a T wall whose wall_info mode it does not know: #wizloadlua knox runs Fort Ludios's des-file over Dlvl 1 without set_wall_state(); with this seed its 50% branch lays des.terrain(36,09,"|") on the map's secret door, which sel_set_ter() had given doormask D_CLOSED, so the new vertical wall keeps mode 4. ^T puts the Priest on the throne-room floor east of that wall, and a ^W wish for "wall" there runs objnam.c wizterrainwish() -> fix_wall_spines() over the hero's 3x3 block, which turns the wall into a TRWALL without touching its flags. ^F (do_mapping) then draws it through back_to_glyph() -> wall_angle(), and C prints impossible("wall_angle: unknown T wall mode 4") among the hwall and vwall reports for the other mode-4 squares. Seed, date, Priest and inputs chosen independently.
